title: Shared input core with host-channel virtual devices, the R240 USB devices, the replay control, and bwm reading /dev/input/events

input-core.why: All nine need /dev/uinput, /dev/input/events, serials, EV_TEXT, removal releases and the ledger (lane 1A, shared code) plus bwm routing from the core.

input-devices.why: keyboard-completion-path and replay-report-fault replay through the port-2 boot keyboard; pointer-completion-path also needs an absolute pointer the R240 lacks (open question Q1).

focus.why: keys-to-focused, text-exact, releases, ctrl-c, navigation-keys and escape need HOSTKEY delivered by the serial host channel into the core's host keyboard and routed by bwm as Linux key codes with releases (the source swap from #2476).
